- Vouched owns full IP. Collaboration with Taktile on PRD requirements is fine; co-building is not.
- Commercial model: subscription (per seat), not volume-based. This sidesteps the committed-revenue problem entirely.

This is the same structure used with vendors for minimum purchase agreements — 10-20% discount in exchange for volume commitment.

Timing: Year 1 (now) is proof of concept. Year 2 is when the traction exists to make this negotiation credible. Begin scoping the terms now so the conversation is ready when traction is established.
